A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RefAlign work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and can be matched despite extensive reformatting and appendix relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original OpenS2V-Eval experiments, loss/depth/encoder ablations, qualitative generation results, and a 30-volunteer user study, with additional evidence in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative examples, and user-study outcomes, including the supplementary results.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.5 retain the same architecture, positive and negative reference-alignment losses, blockwise alignment, overall objective, and inference procedure. No method component is added or altered.

E1.justification: Both use OpenS2V-5M and Phantom-Data for training and OpenS2V-Eval for reference-to-video evaluation. The single- and multi-reference scenarios and supplementary qualitative examples are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same configurations of Vidu, Pika, Kling, Saber, VACE, SkyReels-A2, Phantom, MAGREF, VINO, Kaleido, and BindWeave. Qualitative and user-study comparisons retain Kling, Phantom, and VINO.

E3.justification: Both report 360K training samples, 180 evaluation videos, 3000 training iterations and 1800 for ablations, the same model sizes and metrics, and the same randomized pairwise study with 30 volunteers. Appendix training stages and sample counts also match.

E4.justification: The loss-component and dual-encoder comparisons, alignment-depth sweep, and encoder-size/type ablations are unchanged in Tables 2–4 and Figures 6–7. The motivation visualizations and supplementary qualitative cases are also retained.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither supplies repeated-run counts, random seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All 280 numerical entries in Tables 1–4 match, including RefAlign TotalScores of 56.30% and 60.42% in Table 1. Figure 8 retains win rates of 59.0%, 44.0%, and 51.7% against Kling, Phantom, and VINO; qualitative examples and reported findings also match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11) retain the same mathematical definitions and objectives, including the negative-term margin and the single-reference special case. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of VFM-guided reference alignment, mitigation of copy–paste artifacts and subject confusion, no additional inference overhead, and leading OpenS2V-Eval TotalScore.

C2.justification: The explanations of encoder behavior, loss effectiveness, and alignment-depth tradeoffs are unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning training-data diversity, 81-frame generation, and incomplete supervision from a single VFM.

D1.justification: Implementation details, optimizer settings, augmentations, sampling and CFG settings, conditioning dropout, reference resolution, and two-stage training details are retained. The code URL and prospective model/code release statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 54 cited works and positioning relative to prior R2V methods and REPA are retained. Changes to reference order, numbering, and publication metadata, including classifier-free guidance and Scaling Zero-Shot Reference-to-Video Generation, do not change research positioning.

P1.justification: Scientific prose and the main section sequence remain essentially unchanged. v2 adds keywords and front-matter details, shortens the acknowledgements, moves appendix text before the references, and relabels A.1–A.5 as A–E. The bibliography is alphabetized and renumbered.

P2.justification: A document-wide switch from preprint to proceedings-style typesetting changes fonts, margins, running headers, captions, spacing, and float placement. Figures and tables are resized and relocated throughout, with Figures 10–11 appearing within the bibliography sequence. All eleven figures and four tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the scientific method, all tabulated results, supplementary evidence, interpretations, limitations, and reproducibility information. The extensive template conversion and minor editorial updates change visual organization but leave evidential support, technical completeness, and substantive clarity essentially unchanged.
